title: Repeat Apartment Moves and the Assisted Living Transfer Fee
content:
Under the Assisted Living Residency and Care Agreement, repeated moves cost more. They are counted by the apartment change fees charged on the residency with a service date in the 24 whole months before the handling date; the service date of an apartment change fee is the date of possession of that move.

| Apartment change fees in the window | Share of the transfer fee |
|---|---|
| Two or more | 1.5 |
| Exactly one | 1.25 |
| None | Unchanged |

The share multiplies the transfer fee before it is rounded once to the cent.

**The window.** A fee counts when fewer than 24 whole months separate its service date from the handling date, a whole month being completed each time the count reaches the same day of the month as the service date. With a hypothetical handling date of 1 July 2026, an apartment change dated 2 July 2024 counts and one dated 1 July 2024 does not.

**Example (hypothetical).** One earlier move in the window: the fee is multiplied by 1.25; on a fee of 650.00 alone that is 812.50.
